rationale: Recent local misses suggest the recurrent-tail/export path is still the live axis, while broader recurrence curricula have destabilized runs. This change stays on the 0031/0004 family and reallocates a small amount of export budget to the tail value path by keeping the last two `attn.c_v.weight` matrices in fp16 and tracking them in the late EMA. The hypothesis is that reverse-tail recurrence is now more limited by value-state reconstruction after int8 roundtrip than by q/k alone, and this is a compact, compile-stable way to improve final exact `int8+zlib` `val_bpb` without reopening the failed curriculum category.
title: Tail Value FP16 Export Widening
